tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong gdong bzhi pa la gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las gzhol ba drung chos rje pas mdzad pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum dbang sgyur dpal ldan nag po che/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes las sprul zhing / /byang shar ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod kyi/ /zhing skyong dbang phyug chen po'i thugs kyi sras/ /sku mdog cher nag zhal bzhi mche ba gtsigs/ /byis pa'i lus can shugs chen srog la brngam/ /dril bu'i sgra sgrogs drag po'i phreng ba can/ /rnam grangs mang po'i ming can mgyogs 'gro zhing / /g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i gri gug 'phyar/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod nang khrag rgyun gsol/ /g.yas 'og ral gris dgra bgegs phye mar rlog /g.yon 'og phreng bas bde chen ye shes 'gugs/ /res 'ga' bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang / /rdo rje dang bcas mdung thung cher rno bas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol zhing / /nyams pa'i dgra bo'i srog rtsa myur du gcod/ /rgyan drug gis rgyan mi mgo'i do shal mdzes/ /stag gi lpags pa'i na bza'i smad g.yogs can/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis sna tshogs pad nyi'i steng / /dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil bzhugs/ /khyod ni rnam 'phrul sna tshogs dpag yas pa/ /ri bo gru 'dzin gangs can bsil ba'i tshal/ /drag tu rgod pa'i dur khrod 'jigs pa'i nang / /ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ gad mo cher bzhad cing / /sa 'og k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ 'brug sgra ltar sgrogs pas/ /phyogs bcu skyong mdzad dus mtshan nag mo che/ /phrin las rnam bzhis nyid thugs dgyes mdzad pa'i/ /yum chen 'jigs gzugs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas/ /zhing skyong sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis skor/ /dam can sprul pa yang sprul srung ma'i tshogs/ /tshur gshegs sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir byon dgyes pas dam rdzas 'di bzhes mdzod/

/dgra bgegs sha khrag bdud rtsi lcags kyu lnga/ /dzam+bu ti ba mi rus sna tshogs dang / /me tog rnying pa bca' ba sna tshogs dang / /sman dang rak+ta phud kyi mchod par bcas/ /zhim po'i bza' btung tshil chen spos kyi dri/ /khrag gis ar+ghaṃ me tog nag po dang / /zhun chen sgron ma zhag gi dri mchog dang / /zhal zas bshos nag rus pa'i rgyan spras pa'i/ /gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub gyis mdzes pa/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas/ /bzhed dgu'i longs spyod phun tshogs 'byung ba 'di/ /bdag la brtser dgongs nyid kyis rab bzhes la/ /gsol cig snoms shig rol cig tshim par mdzod/ /ji ltar phul ba bzhin du bzhes nas kyang / /sngon gyi dam bcas g.yel bar ma mdzad par/ /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i las 'di myur du bsgrubs/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa'i dgra bgegs dang / /lam la bar du gcod pa'i bdud rigs rnams/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdzu 'phrul nyams pa dang / /gsad bskrad dbye rmongs ngag sems bcings pa dang / /lus bsregs tshos la zhal du gsol bar mdzod/ /gang yang bdag sogs bstan 'dzin de dag la/ /nyid kyis rjes dgongs bcol ba'i las mdzad de/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub kun stsal nas/ /bsam pa'i don rnams chos bzhin grub par mdzod/ /dpal gdong bzhi pa la gtor ma bstab pa btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba mchog tu grub par gyur cig slob dpon ma kun dga' 'bum bdag chen mas bskul ba'i don du sa skyar mdzad gsung // //maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 bla ma dam pa/ gdong bzhi pa la gtor 'bul dang phrin bcol/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
